Entry Etiquette and Judgment in Dorne Entry Etiquette and Judgment in Dorne The legal system allows women to inherit and value the tradition of princes. Etiquette here is not only about dignity, but also about not being defined by outsiders. When a person is called "just", the local people may not agree with the Southern Palace. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
